name: B Laser Loader – Show Visitors Your Pages Are Loading in Style
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Never leave visitors staring at a blank screen – show a sleek loading progress bar at the top of every page, just like popular streaming and publishing sites.

Live Demo

Why B Laser Loader?

When a page takes a moment to load, visitors want to know something is happening. B Laser Loader adds a smooth loading progress bar at the top of the page to indicate that the next page is loading – the same familiar UI pattern you see on YouTube and Medium.

The plugin automatically detects the loading progress percentage and displays it in the loader, so you get a beautiful, accurate loading indicator without writing any code. Set up the appearance once from the settings page and every page load on your site gets the polished treatment.

Free Features

  • Laser-Style Progress Bar: A smooth loading bar at the top of the page, like popular streaming and publishing sites.
  • Automatic Progress Detection: Detects loading progress percentages and displays them in the loader.
  • Customizable Appearance: Set up how the progress bar looks from the settings page.
  • Responsive: Works across devices.

How to Use

  1. Download and activate the plugin.
  2. Navigate to Tools → B laser.
  3. Set up the appearance of the progress bar.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Enjoy – your loading bar is live on every page!

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “B Laser Loader”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Tools → B laser to configure the progress bar.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the appearance under Tools → B laser.
sections.faq:
How does the loading bar work?

The plugin automatically detects the page loading progress percentage and displays it as a smooth progress bar at the top of the page – no manual configuration of the progress logic is needed.

Can I customize how the progress bar looks?

Yes. Navigate to Tools → B laser in your dashboard to set up the appearance of the progress bar, then save your changes.

Is this the same effect as on YouTube or Medium?

Yes, it follows the same familiar UI pattern – a slim loading bar at the top of the page that fills as the next page loads.

Do I need to write any code?

No. Just install and activate the plugin, configure the appearance once, and the loading bar appears automatically on page loads.
